content:
Jamie: Heads-up — Hypatia SSO/SCIM PoC request landed. They want SAML (IdP & SP flows), SCIM user+group provisioning, and RBAC mapping for three roles. Also need domain proof for corp domains.
Olivia: Do they want full SCIM bulk import or just delta sync validation?
Jamie: Both. Initial bulk (CSV -> SCIM) then ongoing delta. They called out group provisioning for team-based RBAC.
Rahul: Technical constraints: if initial import hits ~8k users we should run bulk off-peak. Will need to verify SCIM bulk endpoints and our pagination/patch support.
Olivia: From their questionnaire: audit retention, SAML cert rotation, SCIM delta semantics, cross-tenant access controls.
Morgan: Security asks: KMS for keys and optional on-prem HSM. They prefer HSM but will accept cloud KMS with contractual assurances (SOC2 + attestation).
Kevin: Commercials: For a 30-day PoC including dedicated support week and audit retention demo, budget estimate depends on token/ops volumes. Provide expected counts.
Jamie: They cited 3 domains: corp.hypatia.com, eng.hypatia.com, support.hypatia.com — need domain ownership proof flow.
Rahul: We support DNS TXT and file-based proof. Recommend DNS TXT for automation.
Olivia: I'll draft a short SCIM runbook with example payloads and expected status codes. Example mapping they requested: External Role->Redwood Role mapping.
Olivia: ```
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "userName":"anna@corp.hypatia.com",
  "name":{"givenName":"Anna","familyName":"Lopez"},
  "emails":[{"value":"anna@corp.hypatia.com","primary":true}],
  "groups":[{"value":"eng-team"}],
  "roles":["Agent"]
}
# Map Agent -> 'hypatia_agent'
```
Rahul: SCIM rate limit guidance for PoC: recommend <= 50 ops/sec sustained, with exponential backoff and honoring Retry-After. Bulk imports should be chunked (500-1k users per request) depending on response times.
Morgan: Audit retention: hosted default 90 days; enterprise add-on supports 365 days. For PoC we can temporarily enable 365d for a demo (commercial add-on may apply).
Kevin: Note: 365d retention in contract is add-on. For the PoC demo we can flip it on as a professional services one-off fee.
Jamie: NameID & assertions: they require persistent NameID, signed assertions, and encrypted assertions if possible. We support signed assertions; encryption needs IdP coordination.
Olivia: Also asked about RBAC scoping per business unit so users from eng.hypatia.com can't access corp resources. We can map domain claims to tenant scoping in Hosted; Dedicated offers stronger isolation.
Rahul: For Dedicated/Private we can run isolated deployments per business unit if they need network separation.
Morgan: I'll prepare a short security annex stating KMS options, audit-retention limits, cert rotation cadence (90d rotation recommended), and support for HSM on contract.
Kevin: I'll prepare two price sketches: Hosted PoC + enterprise support week, and Dedicated short-term trial (small pool). Include optional HSM migration pricing.
Jamie: Actions: Olivia = SCIM runbook & test checklist by EOD tomorrow. Rahul = bulk/delta sync plan + rate limits. Morgan = security annex draft. Kevin = PoC pricing sketches. Everyone join kickoff Wed 10am PT.
Olivia: I'll add test cases: initial import success/failure modes, group sync, idempotency, and conflict resolution examples.
Rahul: Also include webhook-style deprovision tests and group rename handling.
Morgan: Question: do we have standard wording for accepting KMS in lieu of HSM for PoC?
Kevin: Yes — KMS + SOC attestation acceptable for PoC. Full HSM requires addendum.

Jamie: Thanks team. I'll loop in legal once Morgan's annex is ready. :thumbsup:
